When it expires, sign in to the same account and detect again. Use a separate sk_ API key for balance, key inventory and model/IP policy editing without keeping the website signed in. tokenCreation.sessionRequired: Log in to the same account in the site tab, then retry. Your account form is kept.
tokenCreation.setupDescription: Create a scoped token in the extension, or copy an existing token from the site.
tokenCreation.siteFallbackSlow: Loading is taking longer than expected. You can create a token on the site and paste the full token here.
tokenCreation.siteFallbackUnavailable: Token creation in the extension is unavailable right now. You can create a token on the site and paste the full token here.
tokenCreation.timeout: Verification timed out. Try again and complete verification on the site.
tokenCreation.title: Create token in extension
tokenCreation.unavailable: Could not read token creation options. Check that this deployment supports scoped Access Tokens and that you are logged in.
tokenCreation.uncertain: The result of the previous attempt is unknown. Refresh and review the token list. Creating again could leave an extra active token.
tokenCreation.validationFailed: The token was created, but validation failed. Retry validation here to keep the same token.
tokenCreation.walletWriteHint: Used by the extension for check-in; the site bundles payments and purchases in this permission.
